item.title: Preschool Application Lottery Opens for 2026/27
item.description:
The Talawanda Preschool lottery application for the 2026/2027 school year is now open for typically developing children. Applications must be completed by January 31, 2026, and the lottery drawing will take place on February 13, 2026. Families will be notified of their placement on the roster or waitlist after February 13th. Questions can be directed to Preschool Coordinator Beth Fuechsl at fuechsle@talawanda.org.

item.title: Food Resources Available for Families
item.description:
The Talawanda School District provides multiple food resources for families in need: - Little Free Pantries are available 24/7 outside every TSD building, restocked weekly - Backpack Program provides weekly food bags on Thursdays/Fridays at elementary buildings (contact building Social Worker) - Emergency Food boxes available for pick-up or delivery within 24 hours - Resources include a calendar of community meals and TOPPS schedule, list of all Butler County food pantries, and SNAP information

item.title: Health Reminder for Flu Season
item.description:
Flu and seasonal illnesses are increasing at school. Please keep students home if they have a fever (100°F or higher), vomiting, diarrhea, significant cough, sore throat with fever, body aches, extreme fatigue, or flu-like symptoms. Students must be fever-free for 24 hours without medication and symptom-free for 24 hours after vomiting or diarrhea before returning to school.

item.title: Little Women Musical Performance at THS
item.description:
Little Women: The Musical will be performed by Talawanda High School Drama Club at the THS Performing Arts Center. This family-friendly Broadway musical tells Louisa May Alcott's 1868 story of the March sisters during the Civil War. Shows are December 5th at 7 PM, December 6th at 2 PM and 7 PM. Tickets are $8 and can be purchased online or with cash at the door. Nearly 20 THS students from all grades participate, with contributions from Oxford community members.

item.title: Food Resources for Talawanda Families
item.description:
Talawanda School District offers multiple food assistance programs for families in need:

  • Little Free Pantries available 24/7 outside every TSD building, restocked weekly or more as needed
  • Backpack Program at all elementary buildings provides weekly food bags on Thursdays/Fridays (contact building Social Worker)
  • Emergency Food boxes available for pick-up or delivery within 24 hours
  • Access a calendar of community meals and TOPPS schedule, list of all Butler County food pantries, and SNAP information via the provided links

item.description:
Seniors must submit their portraits for the 2026 yearbook by March 27th. Upload photos at snap.yearbookforever.com using access code talawanda2026. Photos must be in portrait format (not landscape), greater than 1MB filesize, follow the student code of conduct, and black and white photos are discouraged.

item.description:

item.description:

Drop off donations to Talawanda High School, Room 611, or have items delivered directly to the school (ATTN: FCCLA Kari Croucher, 5301 University Park Blvd., Oxford, OH 45056). The drive is TSD approved for distribution.
